mechanism: Galantamine (cholinesterase inhibitor) enhances cholinergic effects while perphenazine (antipsychotic) has anticholinergic properties, creating opposing pharmacodynamic effects and increasing risk of adverse CNS and cardiac effects.
action: Monitor for reduced antipsychotic efficacy and increased cholinergic side effects; consider alternative antipsychotic with less anticholinergic activity or adjust dosing with close clinical monitoring.
